_note: Model-specific facts live here and nowhere else, so the prompts stay model-agnostic (art direction section 8). `router` is the id the GPU Router serves, `name` is what the manifest records. `negativePrompt` is true only for a model that honours a negative prompt; a distilled turbo model at CFG 1.0 does not, so it gets positive phrasing only.

boogu_image_turbo.name: Boogu/Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo
boogu_image_turbo.notes: Apache-2.0. 4 steps, CFG 1.0, 1K native. Counting is weak (about 22 percent on ImageBench), so counts above seven are never asked for. Waiting on cluster hardware when this rig was written.

mage_flow_turbo.name: microsoft/Mage-Flow-Turbo
mage_flow_turbo.notes: Stand-in used for the dry run. 4 steps, CFG 1.0, no negative prompt. Serial only: four concurrent requests wedged it. About 1 request in 25 returns an intermittent 500.

mage_flow_edit_turbo.name: microsoft/Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo
mage_flow_edit_turbo.notes: Editing variant; the model the art direction was calibrated on.
